_note: GDELT 2.0 Global Knowledge Graph 15-minute files as leads (scripts/gdelt-gkg.mjs, no AI model; owner 2026-11-21: the DOC search API answered 429, 403 and timeouts from our address, the raw files are plain downloads from data.gdeltproject.org). streams: english (<ts>.gkg.csv.zip) and translation (<ts>.translation.gkg.csv.zip, the 65 other languages GDELT machine-translates; the page title stays in the original language). catch_up_files: after a gap, at most this many missed 15-minute files per stream per run (newest first; 8 = 2 hours). retry_hours: a listed file the server does not have yet (404) is tried again for this long. cyber_themes: GKG theme names checked in 14,591 real rows of 2026-11-21 (CYBER_ATTACK 214 rows, TAX_FNCACT_HACKERS 73, TAX_FNCACT_HACKER 20, WB_2457_CYBER_CRIME 2); SURVEILLANCE, WB_2369_DATA_PRIVACY and SOC_RANSOM (kidnap ransoms) are left out as mostly not cyber incidents. A row is kept when its themes match AND its headline reads as cyber (the feed filter's words in many languages) or the themes are mentioned at least min_theme_mentions times. max_leads_per_run: most theme mentions first. max_per_title: at most this many leads with the same headline per run (syndicated copies, e.g. a dozen local stations running one wire story). grid_themes are only counted (last_run.grid_rows), never filed: see grid_note. The owner may change any of this.
grid_note: GKG power-outage themes exist and are counted, but are not filed into data/grid/news.json: scripts/grid-news.mjs needs a place and stated figures from the headline and summary, GKG gives neither a summary nor the article text, and POWER_OUTAGE also tags passing mentions (outage in a game, a phone network, a past storm). Revisit after the week of clean running.
doc_api_note: The DOC API collectors (scripts/osint.mjs 'gdelt', scripts/grid-news.mjs gdelt_queries) stay until gdelt-gkg has run cleanly for a week (from 2026-11-21); the owner then retires them.
